basic_profile.bio: A former Jehovah's Witness who has recently taken the brave step of disassociating after 28 years in the faith. Passionate about personal growth and finding new paths in life. Based in the Pacific Northwest, I work as a freelance graphic designer and enjoy hiking, photography, and discovering new music. I'm a night owl, often online during late hours exploring subreddits related to personal development, fashion, and humor. Currently single and focused on self-discovery and healing.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Having been raised in a religious community with strict norms, I have a deep understanding of religious doctrine and community dynamics. Over the years, I've become self-taught in graphic design through online courses and tutorials, leading to my current occupation. My experience with leaving the faith has also given me insights into personal transformation and mental health.
